about.title: A technical profile with a practical eye
about.description: I enjoy building useful, well-organized solutions designed for real problems.

who.title: Who I am
who.text: I'm Agustín Tacconi, a web developer and professional chef. For 2 years I've been building projects with JavaScript, React, Node and MongoDB. I like building useful solutions to real problems, combining logic, design and a practical mindset.

seek.title: What I'm looking for
seek.text: I'm looking to step into the professional world of web development, take part in real projects and keep growing as a developer. I don't limit myself to one area: I'm interested in front-end, back-end and continuing to learn tools like AWS. I'm motivated as much by simple tasks as by challenges that push me to improve.

how.title: How I work
how.text: I work in an organized, responsible, step-by-step way. First I make sure I understand the problem, break it into simple parts and keep a clear structure of folders, components and functions. When an error shows up, I investigate, try alternatives and ask for help when needed. I adapt equally to solo work and teamwork.

projects.title: Work that shows how I've grown

tech.title: How I build a complete application
tech.description: Tools and technologies I connect to build interfaces, APIs, databases and usable systems.
tech.summary: For 2 years I've combined these tools to build complete applications, from the interface to the database.
